notes.title: Version 1.6 released
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.6[/b] (11 July 2021):
-Added a separate Run button (Shift).
-Every other button on a gamepad is now the Action button, and every other button is the Run button.
-Added an Always run option.
-Swapped Doc and Ron's dialogue to make it less confusing, now that Becker tells you about the Run button.
-Fixed the screen not immediately scaling when changing the Window scale option in the pause menu.

notes.title: Princess Remedy 2 released!
notes.notes:
'Princess Remedy in a Heap of Trouble' is now available on steam!

The theme of love is back, and this time Remedy can date anyone she's healed to have them accompany her on her travels. Each companion offers a different ability in Healing Mode, such as Dash, Homing shots and Injection. 

Fight more bosses! Find more secrets! Bring your date to the dance ball!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/522040/

notes.title: Princess Remedy 2
notes.notes:
Today we can announce the upcoming release of Princess Remedy – In A Heap of Trouble!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ol5SuTlI9dg]Teaser Trailer[/url]

It’s the prequel to PR – In A World of Hurt, the game we jammed together during the Games Against Ebola jam in November 2014 and then released for free on Steam a year later. We were blown away by the reception and since we had such a blast making the first one everyone was excited to do a new one.

We’ll release a lot more info and trailer in the coming month! Princess Remedy – In A Heap of Trouble will be released on Steam this summer!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11381653/f9638877bcf14c14b90fbe0d06426115857f434a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Princess Remedy featured in Card City Nights
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Princess Remedy, Frallan, Ducklord and many other favorite characters from the World of Hurt are now featured in Card City Nights!

Card City Nights is our "Ludosity All-Stars" card battle game with characters from all across the Ludo City-verse (Ludiverse? iunno) in a fun story setting, a creative new take on the battle mechanics, and absolutely no F2P allowed! =)

This update to CCN is completely free, and live on Steam now. 
Check it out here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/271820
